capabilities.justification: Reads the corpus directory, the package's evidence.bindings, the Warrant spec, the library module it imports and the production source tree it digests; paths are supplied on the command line.
Writes the lane manifest and its domain-labels.json sidecar, and only for an unfaulted, unfiltered, fully passing run.
WARRANT_EVIDENCE_FAULT, WARRANT_EVIDENCE_FILTER and WARRANT_EVIDENCE_OUT select the sabotage and output behaviour of a run (VER04i 4.3).
The sabotage command re-executes the same Node binary on the same runner to prove that a faulted run exits non-zero and prints `not ok`.

justification: Test-time evidence runner: it reads the corpus and binding, imports the one library under test, writes its manifest and runs one child process per control for sabotage. It opens no network connection.
